# Method Print

#### Print(DocumentId, PrintColorMapping, int)

Prints a document to the active printer.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 6, 0, 0)]
void Print(DocumentId inDocumentId, PrintColorMapping inColorMapping, int inResolution)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  DocumentId |  inDocumentId |  Document to print.  |  
 
|  PrintColorMapping |  inColorMapping |  Color conversion mode.  |  
 
|  int |  inResolution |  Print resolution in dot-per-inch.  |  

##### Remarks

This method is available since v7.6.
